spec.rule: Restrict rejection extrema to observations since the actual 6-second approach-origin quote. Do not reuse an older touch from the broader 12-second context. Historical and candle-route implementations share this ordering. Breakout logic and existing tolerances remain unchanged.
spec.holdout: 11/13/17/20 UTC windows registered before this implementation and before inspecting baseline/candidate results.
caveats: Already inspected development windows are exploratory.
All external windows are from one Forex day, not broker OTC or settlements.
Known video has no native OHLC.
Synthetic outcomes are stress behavior, not real accuracy.

limitations: External Dukascopy Forex data, not IQ Option/Exnova OTC and not the user session.
1m OHLC aggregated from the source ticks, not broker-supplied native candles.
No interpolation or invented ticks; evaluate on actual quoted prices and timestamps.
